subject: Discovery recap & next steps - Demo scheduling (FinPath)

Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & next steps (FinPath)

Hi Jake / Lena,

Thanks again for taking the time today - really appreciated the context on FinPath's document ingestion pipeline and the two high-level use cases you mentioned (customer support summarization + internal compliance search). Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- Primary constraints: P95 latency target ~200ms for short queries, expected burst of ~200 qps during EOD processing, and strict data isolation requirements for PII.
- Current environment: Azure-managed infra; procurement will need SOC 2 artifacts and legal redlines.
- Success criteria: reduce average support-handling time by 30% and provide reliable semantically-ranked results for compliance lookups.

Next steps: schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive/demo where we can walk through the architecture, expected performance profiles, and security controls. Can you share 2-3 windows next week that work for your platform and security folks? I can loop in our SE and security contact to join.

Attaching the SOC 2 questionnaire we typically share - it has the items your security team usually asks about.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
